title: Orange Flavoured Wedding (FCP 2026)
synopsis: It is March 1978 in the suburbs of Nantes. The Puig family has seven children, and today is the wedding of the youngest: Jacques. The father is not attending the wedding; he has been banished from the family. The brothers and sisters, however, are all there, happy to be reunited. Jacques is marrying Martine. For the two of them, it’s a marriage of love. But can love heal the wounds of childhood?

synopsis_lang.en: It is March 1978 in the suburbs of Nantes. The Puig family has seven children, and today is the wedding of the youngest: Jacques. The father is not attending the wedding; he has been banished from the family. The brothers and sisters, however, are all there, happy to be reunited. Jacques is marrying Martine. For the two of them, it’s a marriage of love. But can love heal the wounds of childhood?
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 1978年3月的南特市郊區。Puig家有七名子女。今天，最年幼的Jacques要結婚了。父親不會出席婚禮，因為他早已被逐出家門，然而，兄弟姊妹全都到齊，為能夠重聚而滿心歡喜。Jacques要娶Martine，對二人而言，這是一場因愛而結合的婚姻，但愛情能否治癒童年的傷口?

cast: Adele Exarchopoulos, Vincent Lacoste, Paul Kircher, Alban Lenoir
